drivers.name: Limited physical scope and continuity
drivers.mechanism: If the waterproofing and substrate remain serviceable, draining, patching, curing and refilling with the incumbent contractor may fit the horizon.

drivers.name: Unresolved coating and water-quality failures
drivers.mechanism: More extensive removal/reapplication or a repeat failure could consume the remaining time; no published firm completion date anchors the schedule.

drivers.name: External interruption
drivers.mechanism: Legal proceedings or administrative changes could interrupt an otherwise feasible repair; the filing establishes a request/reserved remedy, not that an injunction will issue.

payload.yes_path: Timely drainage reveals mainly local defects; retained contractor repairs and tests the system, followed by refill and normal operation before September.
payload.no_path: Scope broadens, repeat defects require more rework, or an external interruption consumes the available time.
unknowns: Exact work commencement and completion dates.
